cues.en: Mike X Cohen: If you are performing multiple statistical tests in the same data, then you are likely to encounter something called the multiple comparisons problem.
cues.zh: Mike X Cohen：如果對相同資料執行多個統計檢定，很可能遇到所謂多重比較問題。

cues.en: And in this video I'm going to explain what multiple comparisons means and why it's a problem.
cues.zh: 這部影片會解釋多重比較是什麼，以及為什麼是問題。

cues.en: And then I will show you a couple formulas including the very simple formula for the most common correction to multiple comparisons problems, and that is the Bonferroni correction.
cues.zh: 再展示幾個公式，包括最常見的多重比較校正，也就是 Bonferroni 校正，非常簡單的公式。

cues.en: And along the way you'll also learn a new term called the familywise error rate, which is related to the type one error rate that you already know about.
cues.zh: 過程中也會學到家族型錯誤率這個新術語，和你已知道的第一類錯誤率有關。

cues.en: Okay, let's get started by considering these three groups.
cues.zh: 先考慮這三組。

cues.en: So imagine we have the blue group, the green group, and the yellow group.
cues.zh: 假設有藍組、綠組和黃組。

cues.en: So how many ways can we compare the means from these three different groups?
cues.zh: 能用幾種方式比較這三組的平均值？

cues.en: How many distinct comparisons can we make?
cues.zh: 能做幾個不同的比較？

cues.en: Well, it turns out in this case we can make three.
cues.zh: 這個情況可以做三個。

cues.en: We can test the hypothesis that the mean of the blue group is different from the mean of the green group.
cues.zh: 檢驗藍組平均值和綠組不同的假設。

cues.en: And then we have blue against yellow and green against yellow.
cues.zh: 再比較藍對黃、綠對黃。

cues.en: And here I'm assuming that the tests are symmetric, of course.
cues.zh: 這裡當然假設檢定對稱。

cues.en: So blue versus green is the same thing as green versus blue.
cues.zh: 所以藍對綠，和綠對藍相同。

cues.en: Okay, so we have three different groups that leads us to three different possible comparisons.
cues.zh: 三個不同群組，會有三個不同的可能比較。

cues.en: And let's say that we are testing each one of these three hypotheses using a P-value threshold of 0.05.
cues.zh: 假設每個假設都用 P 值門檻 0.05 檢驗。

cues.en: So pretty standard 5% probability for our statistical threshold.
cues.zh: 相當標準，以 5% 機率作為統計門檻。

cues.en: Now the problem here is that probabilities are additive.
cues.zh: 問題是，機率具有可加性。

cues.en: So we can add up these probabilities because they are independent.
cues.zh: 因為它們獨立，所以可以將機率相加。

cues.en: So we have three tests that we are running in the same data.
cues.zh: 在相同資料上，執行三個檢定。

cues.en: We evaluate each test using a P-value of 0.05.
cues.zh: 每個檢定用 P=0.05 評估。

cues.en: These are all probabilities so we can add them together.
cues.zh: 它們都是機率，所以可以加總。

cues.en: And that's, you know, based on some assumptions including that these tests, these probabilities are independent of each other.
cues.zh: 這當然基於一些假設，包括檢定、機率彼此獨立。

cues.en: I'm gonna get back to this point in a little bit.
cues.zh: 等一下會回到這點。

cues.en: So if we wanna know the probability of incorrectly rejecting the null hypothesis in at least one of these, so imagine that we consider these three hypotheses
cues.zh: 如果想知道，至少其中一個錯誤拒絕虛無假設的機率，可以把這三個假設

cues.en: to be a set or a family, we could call them, it's a family of tests that we are running.
cues.zh: 視為一組，或稱為一個檢定家族。

cues.en: What is the probability of this one being incorrectly labeled as statistically significant?
cues.zh: 這個被錯誤標為統計顯著的機率是多少？

cues.en: Well that's 0.05, but this one's also 0.05, this one's 0.05.
So that means that all three of these together we have the sum of all these three probabilities gives us a probability of 0.15 or 15% that at least one of these hypotheses
cues.zh: 所以三個合在一起，機率相加得到 0.15，或 15%，表示至少一個假設

cues.en: will be incorrectly labeled as statistically significant.
cues.zh: 被錯誤標為統計顯著。

cues.en: So this is a problem.
cues.zh: 這是問題。

cues.en: This gives us an unacceptably high false alarm rate.
cues.zh: 會產生高到無法接受的誤報率。

cues.en: So again, the false alarm rate of any one hypothesis is not unacceptably high, that's our standard 0.05.
cues.zh: 單一假設的誤報率沒有高到無法接受，是標準的 0.05。

cues.en: But when we sum up all of these probabilities because we're gonna do all of these tests, then the probability becomes 15% that at least one of these will give us a false alarm
cues.zh: 但全部都做、把機率加總後，至少一個產生誤報的機率，就變成 15%，

cues.en: or type one error.
cues.zh: 也就是第一類錯誤。

cues.en: So that is really unacceptably high.
cues.zh: 這真的太高。

cues.en: And you know, this is only three tests.
cues.zh: 而且才三個檢定。

cues.en: We can imagine going back here.
cues.zh: 可以想像回到這裡。

cues.en: Let's say in addition to these three hypotheses, we want to test three other hypotheses that says, you know, the mean of this group is different from zero
cues.zh: 除了這三個假設，還想檢驗另外三個，也就是這組的平均值是否不同於 0，

cues.en: or you know, whatever other null hypothesis value is appropriate.
cues.zh: 或任何適當的虛無假設值。

cues.en: So we can test whether this is different, has a mean that's different from some value.
cues.zh: 可以檢驗這組的平均值是否和某個值不同。

cues.en: And this one and this one have means that's different from some value.
cues.zh: 這組和這組也一樣。

cues.en: So you can imagine that we could actually create a set of hypotheses that contains six different tests and then you know, six times 0.05 would be 30%.
cues.zh: 於是可以建立六個不同檢定的假設集合，6×0.05=30%。

cues.en: So in that case, if you know, if you add three more to this set, we would have a false alarm rate of 30%.
cues.zh: 在這個集合再加三個，就會有 30% 誤報率。

cues.en: So 30% probability that at least one of our six hypotheses is a false alarm.
cues.zh: 六個假設中至少一個誤報的機率為 30%。

cues.en: Okay, so that's really problematic to say the least.
cues.zh: 至少可以說，這非常有問題。

cues.en: Now this distinction between the probability of one test versus the probability of any test in a set that is called the familywise error rate.
cues.zh: 單一檢定的機率，和整組中任一檢定的機率之間的區別，稱為家族型錯誤率。

cues.en: So the familywise error rate is the probability of at least one hypothesis or at least one test in your set of tests is a false alarm.
cues.zh: 家族型錯誤率，就是一組檢定中，至少一個假設、至少一個檢定誤報的機率。

cues.en: Now the problem is that the familywise error rate, this is often abbreviated as FWE sometimes FWER.
cues.zh: 通常簡寫為 FWE，有時是 FWER。

cues.en: The problem is that the true underlying familywise error rate is not really possible to calculate.
cues.zh: 問題是，真正的家族型錯誤率，其實無法直接計算。

cues.en: And why is it impossible to calculate?
cues.zh: 為什麼無法計算？

cues.en: Well, it's impossible to calculate because probabilities being additive assumes that these tests are 100% purely entirely independent of each other.
cues.zh: 因為機率可加，假設檢定百分之百、完全彼此獨立。

cues.en: And if they're not independent of each other, they're dependent on each other, then you cannot simply add the probabilities.
cues.zh: 如果不獨立、彼此相依，就不能直接把機率相加。

cues.en: You have to include some scaling factor that would account for that correlation between the different tests.
cues.zh: 必須加入某個縮放因子，考慮不同檢定的相關。

cues.en: So in practice it's not really possible to know the true familywise error rate.
cues.zh: 所以實務上，無法真正知道家族型錯誤率。

cues.en: So therefore the solution is that we estimate the maximum possible familywise error rate and then we build some statistical adjustment based on that
cues.zh: 解決方式是估計最大可能的家族型錯誤率，再根據這個

cues.en: estimated maximum familywise error rate.
cues.zh: 估計的最大錯誤率，建立統計調整。

cues.en: I'm gonna show you the formula in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下展示公式。

cues.en: I just wanna point out one thing about this abbreviation, FWE, because I see this a bajillion times when I read other people's writing.
cues.zh: 先提醒 FWE 這個縮寫的一點，因為看別人的文章時，看過無數次。

cues.en: When you were writing out familywise error rate in you know, Microsoft Word or Google Docs or whatever, your auto correct is likely to correct this
cues.zh: 在 Microsoft Word、Google Docs 等工具寫家族型錯誤率，縮寫常會被自動校正，

cues.en: or to change this to FEW.
cues.zh: 改成 FEW。

cues.en: You know, your computer thinks that you want to type few, so just be mindful of that when you're writing about the familywise error rate, make sure your auto correct
cues.zh: 電腦以為你要打 few，所以寫家族型錯誤率時要留意，確保自動校正

cues.en: is not changing this to few, okay?
cues.zh: 沒有把它改成 few，好嗎？

cues.en: Anyway, here are the two formulas that are commonly used for calculating the maximum familywise error rate.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡是兩個常用的最大家族型錯誤率計算公式。

cues.en: So we say that the true familywise error rate is probably less than or equal to either this term or this term.
cues.zh: 真正家族型錯誤率，大概小於或等於這一項，或這一項。

cues.en: N times alpha is a very simple formula where alpha is the probability threshold that we are using.
cues.zh: N×α 很簡單，α 是使用的機率門檻。

cues.en: So you know, typically 5%.
cues.zh: 通常是 5%。

cues.en: So alpha would equal 0.05.
N is the number of tests.
cues.zh: N 是檢定次數。

cues.en: So in the previous slide I calculated based on this formula, we had three tests and then I gave a further example of six tests.
cues.zh: 上一張就是依此計算，有三個檢定，之後又舉六個的例子。

cues.en: So, but three tests was on the slides and then alpha of 0.05 and that's how I arrived at a maximum possible familywise error rate of 15%.
cues.zh: 投影片有三個檢定、α=0.05，因此得到最大可能家族型錯誤率 15%。

cues.en: Here's another formula which says one minus the quantity, one minus alpha.
cues.zh: 另一個公式是，1 減去括號中的 1−α，

cues.en: So this term would typically be 0.95 to the power of N.
cues.zh: 括號內通常是 0.95，再取 N 次方。

cues.en: Again, where N is the number of tests, same as as this formula here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，N 是檢定次數，和這個公式相同。

cues.en: Now you can see the less than or equal to signs here.
cues.zh: 可以看到小於等於符號。

cues.en: That's because this is more stringent, this is more conservative, this is a little bit more lenient and we don't really know what the true familywise error rate is because yeah, that depends on the relationships
cues.zh: 因為這個更嚴格、更保守，另一個稍微寬鬆，而不真正知道家族型錯誤率，因為取決於

cues.en: between the different hypotheses or the different tests, I should say, not the hypotheses between the different tests, statistical tests.
cues.zh: 不同假設，應該說不同檢定，不是假設，而是統計檢定之間的關係。

cues.en: And that's just difficult or impossible to know a priori.
cues.zh: 這很難，甚至不可能事先知道。

cues.en: So on the next slide, I wanna show you what these two formulas look like.
cues.zh: 下一張想展示這兩個公式的樣子。

cues.en: So here I am assuming an alpha rate of 0.05.
cues.zh: 這裡假設 α=0.05。

cues.en: So I fixed alpha to be 0.05 and I just explored what the familywise error rate would be for these two different formulas.
cues.zh: 固定 α 為 0.05，探索兩個不同公式所給的家族型錯誤率。

cues.en: So again, what the Y-axis is showing here is the probability that at least one test in your set of tests that you are running
cues.zh: Y 軸顯示的，是在相同資料集上執行的整組檢定中，至少一個檢定

cues.en: on the same dataset, at least one test is a false alarm.
cues.zh: 產生誤報的機率。

cues.en: That's the Y-axis and the X-axis here is the number of tests that you are running.
cues.zh: 這是 Y 軸，X 軸則是檢定次數。

cues.en: So yeah, you can see that the additive assumption over here gives us this linear, maybe I could have called this linear instead of additive.
cues.zh: 可加性假設得到這條直線，也許應該叫線性，而不是可加。

cues.en: The assumption is that the probabilities are additive.
cues.zh: 假設機率可以相加。

cues.en: This goes up higher, and then we, here we have this exponential formula which slowly increases.
cues.zh: 這條上升較高，這裡則是慢慢增加的指數公式。

cues.en: Now one, you know, kind of awkward thing about this formula here is that you can actually get probabilities greater than one as soon as you get above 20 basically.
cues.zh: 這個公式有點尷尬的是，基本上超過 20 個檢定，就可能得到大於 1 的機率。

cues.en: And for an alpha of 0.05, the way to interpret that is that basically with, you know, if you're running more than 20 tests, you are pretty much guaranteed
cues.zh: α=0.05 時，解讀方式是，執行超過 20 個檢定，基本上幾乎保證

cues.en: to get at least one false alarm in your set.
cues.zh: 整組中至少有一個誤報。

cues.en: And that will be the way to interpret this.
cues.zh: 可以這樣解讀。

cues.en: This formula here, what I'm calling the exponential formula that actually never gets above one or it never even gets to one.
cues.zh: 我稱為指數公式的這個，則永遠不會超過 1，甚至不會真正到 1。

cues.en: You can imagine that if this term here is 0.95, you raise this to higher and higher powers.
cues.zh: 想像括號內是 0.95，取越來越高次方。

cues.en: So this term gets smaller, it approaches zero, which means that this approach is one.
cues.zh: 這項會越來越小、趨近 0，所以整體趨近 1。

cues.en: Okay, so mo' comparisons, mo' problems.
cues.zh: 比較越多，問題越多。

cues.en: I hope you now realize and appreciate the problem of false positives that can arise when you run multiple statistical tests.
cues.zh: 希望現在能理解、體會，執行多個統計檢定時可能出現的偽陽性問題。

cues.en: Okay, so now what is the solution?
cues.zh: 那解決方式是什麼？

cues.en: Well, there are actually several solutions.
cues.zh: 其實有好幾種。

cues.en: There are several ways to adjust your P-value thresholds for your statistical tests to accommodate the multiple comparisons problem.
cues.zh: 可以用幾種方式調整統計檢定的 P 值門檻，處理多重比較問題。

cues.en: The most common one is given to us by the Italians and in particular one Italian, this guy named Bonferroni.
cues.zh: 最常見的來自義大利人，特別是這位叫 Bonferroni 的人。

cues.en: And now I have to admit, I don't know for sure that Bonferroni was Italian.
cues.zh: 必須承認，不確定他是不是義大利人。

cues.en: He certainly has an Italian name.
cues.zh: 名字肯定很義大利。

cues.en: So let's just say that the solution to us is given by someone of probably Italian descent and possibly he himself was Italian.
cues.zh: 所以先說，解法來自一位可能有義大利血統、也可能本人就是義大利人的學者。

cues.en: Anyway, Bonferroni was a statistician in the 20th century and he gave us amongst other gems in statistics, the Bonferroni correction.
cues.zh: 總之，Bonferroni 是 20 世紀統計學家，除了其他統計寶物，也給了我們 Bonferroni 校正。

cues.en: It's very simple, it's very straightforward.
cues.zh: 非常簡單、直接。

cues.en: You simply set the new alpha threshold to be the threshold of an individual statistical test divided by the number of tests.
cues.zh: 只要把新 α 門檻，設為單一檢定的門檻除以檢定次數。

cues.en: So you can see where this formula comes from.
cues.zh: 可以看出公式的來源。

cues.en: It's basically making this assumption of linearly additive probabilities.
cues.zh: 基本上假設機率線性相加。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the Bonferroni correction.
cues.zh: 這就是 Bonferroni 校正。

cues.en: Super simple.
cues.zh: 超簡單。

cues.en: So we say that each individual test is tested at 0.05 and we have, let's say three tests.
cues.zh: 假設每個檢定原本用 0.05，共有三個檢定。

cues.en: So then the Bonferroni corrected threshold would be 0.05 divided by three.
cues.zh: Bonferroni 校正門檻就是 0.05 除以 3。

cues.en: So that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 看起來像這樣。

cues.en: So again, we're making this assumption that the probabilities are additive.
cues.zh: 同樣，假設機率可相加。

cues.en: So the probability of any given statistical test in our set is going to be 0.05 divided by three.
cues.zh: 這組任一檢定的機率，都是 0.05/3。

cues.en: And then we sum those all up and obviously we get back to 0.05.
cues.zh: 全部相加，顯然回到 0.05。

cues.en: The math is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 數學相當直接。

cues.en: So that kind of solves the problem.
cues.zh: 這樣就解決問題。

cues.en: The probability of false alarm in the entire set is 5%.
cues.zh: 整組的誤報機率為 5%。

cues.en: Now I would like to point out the difference between the probability of the familywise error, so the whole family of tests versus the probability
cues.zh: 要指出整個檢定家族的家族型錯誤機率，和

cues.en: of, or the alpha rate of an individual test.
cues.zh: 單一檢定機率、α 水準之間的差別。

cues.en: So 0.05 is the entire set of tests that we are measuring, but each individual test is evaluated
cues.zh: 0.05 是整組測量的檢定，但每個個別檢定，

cues.en: using a P-value threshold of 0.016 and and so on.
cues.zh: 使用的是 0.016 等等的 P 值門檻。

cues.en: So Bonferroni solves the problem of multiple comparisons by contracting the, or fixing the familywise error rate
cues.zh: 所以 Bonferroni 透過限制，或固定家族型錯誤率

cues.en: to be 0.05 and that makes the individual test be more stringent.
cues.zh: 為 0.05，解決多重比較問題，讓個別檢定更嚴格。

cues.en: So that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 這部影片到這裡。

cues.en: I introduced you to the multiple comparisons problem, what it means and why it causes difficulties and frustrations.
cues.zh: 介紹了多重比較問題、意義，以及為什麼造成困難和困擾。

cues.en: I showed you two different formulas for computing they're estimating the maximum familywise error rate, and the more stringent formula, the more conservative formula
cues.zh: 展示兩個計算，或估計最大家族型錯誤率的公式，而較嚴格、較保守的公式，

cues.en: leads to the Bonferroni correction, which is the most commonly used correction for multiple comparisons in statistics.
cues.zh: 導出 Bonferroni 校正，是統計中最常使用的多重比較校正。

cues.en: The last thing I want to mention in this video is that Bonferroni correction is not the only way to correct for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: 最後還想提，Bonferroni 不是唯一方式。

cues.en: There's also something called the FDR, the false discovery rate, there's cluster-based correction if you have spatially or temporally correlated data like time series data or images.
cues.zh: 還有所謂 FDR，也就是偽發現率；如果資料具有空間或時間相關，例如時間序列或影像，還有群集校正。

cues.en: There's other kinds of corrections based on non-parametric statistical tests and so on.
cues.zh: 也有根據無母數檢定等其他校正。

cues.en: So, but these other methods tend to be specific to particular types of problems or particular characteristics of the data.
cues.zh: 但這些方法通常針對特定問題類型，或特定資料特徵。

cues.en: Bonferroni correction is certainly the most commonly used correction for multiple comparisons.
cues.zh: Bonferroni 肯定是最常使用的多重比較校正。
